patterns.note: Hero image employs a subtle parallax effect, where the background image scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a sense of depth as the user scrolls down.
The primary navigation bar transforms from a transparent overlay to a compact, solid-background sticky header with a slightly smaller logo once the user scrolls past the initial hero section.
Prominent use of full-bleed, high-quality photography as section heroes and background elements, often with subtle text overlays and clear calls to action.
A sophisticated pairing of a classic serif display font for major headings and a clean, extended sans-serif for body text and functional elements, creating an editorial and authoritative feel.
A restrained, earthy color palette dominated by deep navy/charcoal, off-white, and a warm, muted gold accent, evoking a sense of heritage and quality.

technique_notes: The site employs a smooth scrolling experience, likely using `locomotive-scroll`, which also drives a subtle parallax effect on hero images, making them scroll slower than the page content.

The primary navigation bar transitions from a transparent overlay to a compact, solid-background sticky header once the user scrolls past the initial hero section, achieved through CSS transformations and background changes.

Content sections appear to reveal themselves with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, enhancing the user's journey down the page, likely orchestrated with `css-keyframes` or a scroll-trigger library.

design_tokens.type_scale: Elegant, large serif headings (~3-4x body) paired with a clean, legible sans-serif body text and smaller uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout, maintaining a crisp and classic aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between sections and within content blocks, contributing to an unhurried, premium feel.

standout: The site distinguishes itself through its sophisticated blend of classic, editorial-style photography and typography with modern, subtle scroll-triggered motion. The use of a refined, earthy color palette and a distinctive serif font for headings elevates the brand beyond typical athletic wear, creating a sense of heritage and luxury.
